stats.done_summary: Implemented numerical integration of the porous-medium traveling-wave ODE (from u_t=(u^m)_{xx}) using solve_ivp (Radau), generated solution/residual outputs (outputs/tw_solution.npz, outputs/summary.json), created required figures (report/images/*.png), and wrote publication-style report with quantitative ODE residual verification (report/report.md).
